'''Sasha Pancho''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She was trained in medicine and beast riding and was skilled at sneaking and hiding and speaking different [[Language/Legends|languages]]. Pancho stood 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and wore a set of [[Clothing/Legends|robes]].<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sasha Pancho was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Pancho's character type was listed as "Female Minor Jedi" and her model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
